description: Archive (soft-delete) a personal product (origin=personal) you own. Removing a product that belongs to the rikma is a consent flow (proposeObjectArchive — members approve, silence approves at restime), so for those this tool returns the moach link instead of archiving. An archived product stays reachable at /gift/[id] for old orders and sales but vanishes from /gift and the storefront catalog. Never a hard delete — history matters. Unarchiving is done in the moach. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#archiveRikmaProductTool

archived.description: true = archive. false (unarchive) is not done here — the tool returns the moach link.

projectId.description: Rikma id the product is listed in.

name: archiveRikmaProductTool
